title: Say Manangiyabawag na Baleg a Delap
intro: Sayan indibidual so nagmaliw a lusek na panagsungdo ed loob na nilasus a taon, ya ontatawag ed sakey a sosyedad ya onsusumpa ed liwawa na katuaan legan ya aarapen so panagludlurey tan panag-ayew. Anggaman ed alablabas iran posibilidad tan say belat na mensahe ya onlabas ed saray kailalakan, sayan lingkor so nansiansian malet ed misyon da anggad nipaway so unor a ganggan.
clues: Siam a lasus tan limamplon taon so inusar ko ed impanawag ko ed saray totook ed dalan na inkatonung, agew tan labi, diad maamut tan diad arap na karaklan.
Pinasakbayan ko ray totook nipaakar ed ansakisakit a dusa, balet inyan da ray gamegamet da ed saray layag da tan insakbongan day inkasikara na kawes da lapud inkatangsit da.
Ingganggan ak ya mangipaalagey na baleg a bengatla diad silong na mabantay a mata na Katawan ko, anggaman anggapoy danum ya nanengneng.
Legan kon mankikimey, dinmalan iray pangulo na totook tan inelek-elekan da ak, balet imbagak ed sikara ya ag mabayag sikami lay manludlurey ed sikara.
Kinerew ko so dilin laman tan dalak ya mila ed siak, balet pinili ran mananap na salimbengan ed palandey, ta manisia ran satan so mangisalba ed sikara manlapud ontatagey a delap.
Say bapor ko et tinmunda ed Palandey Judi kayari ya inakmon na dalin so danum to tan tinmunda so maksil ya uran na tawen.

arabic: وَقِيلَ يَـٰٓأَرْضُ ٱبْلَعِى مَآءَكِ وَيَـٰسَمَآءُ أَقْلِعِى وَغِيضَ ٱلْمَآءُ وَقُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ وَٱسْتَوَتْ عَلَى ٱلْجُودِىِّ ۖ وَقِيلَ بُعْدًۭا لِّلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verse: And it was said, "O earth, swallow your water, and O sky, withhold [your rain]." And the water subsided, and the matter was accomplished, and it [i.e., the ship] came to rest on the [mountain of] Jūdiyy. And it was said, "Away with the wrongdoing people." (11:44)
